items.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019
items.q: And it was Jon Bon Jovi was the lead singer of this band, the Atlantic City Expressway that we started, he started. We were founding members.

ctx.x: Is it, if you never had a nine to five maybe you can’t answer this but is it harder to have a family life so to speak being a musician as opposed to a banker?

I don’t know what a banker lives like. I have no idea. I had a bunch of jobs when I was like my first couple of years in high school. I’ve been doing this a long time. So when I was like 15 I got a call to join — I’ve been very fortunate. I was 15 and I got a call to join a band starting in Sayreville. And the rehearsal, I knew a guy from the drum and bugle corps that went to Sayreville High School and he says this guy’s starting a band and he’s looking for a trumpet player, here’s the address, go talk to this…
full time job? He goes no I’m a band director. I’m like that’s amazing where are you — ? He’s like I’m the band director at J.P. Stevens High School. And I was like, I’m at the bar.
